integrity: All constituent formulas are given explicitly; every finite interpolation instance is deterministically checked by the standalone Python standard-library program. The reported period is the least period on the actual prime-power domain, justified using Dirichlet primes and compatibility of congruence classes. No claim is made of an independent general orbit-counting method.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts only zero-constant permutation-polynomial functions of exact index six. The infinite result relies on the established general degree-five quasi-polynomial theorem of Fan and uses 72 exact finite prime-field evaluations to determine the coefficient polynomials. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact index-six quasi-multiplicative orbit counts and sharp period twelve
